verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a broad API surface: Checkout API flows, Management API operations for merchant accounts, terminals, webhooks, payment method settings, users, API credentials and allowed origins, and OpenAPI specs for every public API. However, nothing in the evidence claims API parity with the Customer Area UI, and several capabilities are described only as UI features: credential roles assigned in the Customer Area, webhook event logs, the risk rule builder interface and visual reporting. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API equivalents for Customer Area functions (role assignment, webhook logs, risk rule building, reporting), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: contains OpenAPI specifications for every public API Adyen offers
plus Management API tools for merchant accounts, terminals (list/reassign/schedule actions/settings), webhooks (list/get/test), payment method settings, users, API credentials, and allowed origins
Your server makes three Checkout API requests: /paymentMethods, /payments, and /payments/details.
